 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_COEXIST (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_man_or_scan in varchar2,
 p_con_scheme in varchar2,
 p_out_unit_id out varchar2) IS
 temp_v_s_unit varchar2(60) := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM');
 temp_v_unit varchar2(60) ;
 temp_v_chk_digit_item varchar2(60);
 temp_v_chk_digit varchar2(2);
BEGIN
 temp_v_unit := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK') || '.' ||get_item_property(temp_v_s_unit, nextitem);
 temp_v_chk_digit_item := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK') || '.' ||
 get_item_property(temp_v_unit, nextitem);
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.validate_ff_value');

 -- Check if Unit is scanned.
 IF p_man_or_scan = 'S' THEN
 -- Check if Unit has a valid scan length.
 IF NVL(length(p_unit_id), 0) not in (9,10,12,16) THEN
 copy(null,temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF NVL(length(p_unit_id), 0) = 16 THEN --Assume to be a ISBT 128 Unit 
 validate_unit_scan_code128( p_unit_id, 'S', '*', p_out_unit_id, 
 temp_v_chk_digit); 
 IF not name_in('GLOBAL.validate_ff_value') = 'N' THEN
 IF NOT validate_unit_ff(substr(p_unit_id,2,5),substr(p_unit_id,15,2),
 name_in('GLOBAL.validate_ff_value')) THEN
 show_error('9724');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Check if Unit has a valid identifier
 
 copy(substr(temp_v_chk_digit,-1), 'GLOBAL.chk_digit');
 copy(temp_v_chk_digit,temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 copy('I','GLOBAL.code_scheme'); 
 ELSE
 Validate_Unit_scan_codabar(p_unit_id,'S',p_con_scheme,p_out_unit_id);
 copy('','GLOBAL.chk_digit');
 copy('','GLOBAL.coll_id'); 
 copy('','GLOBAL.coll_year'); 
 copy('C','GLOBAL.code_scheme');
 copy('',temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 When form_trigger_failure then
 copy('',temp_v_s_unit);
 copy('',temp_v_unit);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;
